faq.a.einzeln: Yes. Every model comes as a pair and as a single earring, for the second piercing or to combine with another pair. The single price sits right next to the pair price on the product page. And if one of them ever goes missing, you replace one, not two.
faq.a.garantie: On manufacturing faults there is a one-year warranty from purchase, with proof of purchase. We repair or replace at no cost to you. Write to us with your order number and a photo, that is enough to begin with. Wear and damage caused by force are excluded.
faq.a.groessen: Earrings do not come in dress sizes. What matters is the post, and it has the same dimensions on every Baqless model. It goes through a normal, healed piercing. What differs is only how large the visible part at the front turns out. Where we have the exact measurements, they are on the product page in millimetres, together with a 1:1 drawing you can hold against your ear.

faq.a.material: The jewellery is Sterling silver 925. Depending on the model rhodium-plated, with 18 carat gold plating or with a black coating. Some models add enamel, cubic zirconia or a freshwater pearl. Only the post that goes through the piercing is surgical stainless steel. The full material list is on every product page, model by model. If you react to certain metals, read that list before you buy.
faq.a.passform: Almost always, but not always. The anchor needs room behind the earlobe for its quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it does not find that room. We would rather tell you before than after. Take your earlobe between thumb and index finger: if it squeezes easily, you have nothing to worry about. If you are unsure,
faq.a.passform_schluss: . We answer honestly, even when the answer is no.
faq.a.retoure: Yes, 30 days from the day it arrives, unworn and in its original packaging, as hygiene demands with ear jewellery. You write us a short message, we send you the return address and a return label, and once the parcel is with us we refund to your original means of payment, as a rule within five working days. The whole process is under
faq.a.versandkosten: From CHF 99 order value we deliver free of charge. Below that a flat rate applies, shown in your cart before you pay. Where import duties are included in the shipping fee, nothing is added at the door and no bill follows from customs. Which countries that covers is set by Baqless before launch. How long it takes depends on the destination country.
faq.a.wasserfest: Stays in in the shower and in the sea. The fastening is water-resistant; sport, soap and salt water do not bother it. One exception: models with a real freshwater pearl are better taken out for showering and swimming. Pearls like neither salt nor soap. It says so on the product page of each of them.
faq.a2.sitzt: After the quarter turn the anchor sits crosswise behind the piercing. Crosswise it is wider than the channel it came through, and it does not find its way back. Only a second quarter turn puts it lengthwise again. You do that deliberately, not by accident. If it sits too loose or too tight, you adjust the grip yourself. How that works is further down.
faq.anlegen.antwort: Push the post in like an ordinary stud, a quarter turn on the earring, click. If it sits too loose or too tight, slide the turned section of the post along a little. That is how you set the grip yourself. It works one-handed, without a mirror.

journal.befunde.durchgehend.text: In the shower, asleep, in the bath.
journal.befunde.fuss: The dots show the same thing as the number beside them. Nothing here is weighted, extrapolated or turned into a percentage.
journal.befunde.robust.text: Even the hoops do not bend out of shape.
journal.befunde.schluss.text: Four of the six come to it by themselves: they forget the earrings are there. Four of the six say nothing goes missing any more. Both hang on the same thing. There is no back that could come loose.
journal.befunde.sub: No survey and no campaign. Six portraits, recorded between 2022 and 2025, each conducted separately. The number says how many of the six raise the point themselves.
journal.befunde.titel: What they say, independently of one another.
journal.befunde.vergessen.text: One tea master only notices in the mirror, after putting on her kimono.
journal.befunde.vergessen.titel: You forget you have them on
journal.befunde.verlust.text: No more checking whether both are still there. Nothing to catch on a scarf.
journal.befunde.vielseitig.text: Neither big nor small, so you reach for them in the morning without hesitating.
journal.brueck.amity.text: The star, the pearl, the pair you can pass on.
journal.brueck.embrace.text: Band, neon, cubic zirconia. For days that are allowed to stand out.
journal.brueck.fakt.material: Sterling silver 925. Only the post behind the ear is surgical stainless steel.
journal.brueck.fakt.wasser: Stays in in the shower and in the sea
journal.brueck.honesty.text: The quiet shapes. Line, curve, leaf, drop.
journal.brueck.kick: From the page to the ear
journal.brueck.label: Collection
journal.brueck.lead: All six wear the same fastening. The shapes differ, the construction does not. Four collections, each with its own character.
journal.brueck.passform.text: Almost always, but not always. The anchor needs room behind the earlobe for its quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it does not find that room. We would rather tell you before than after.
journal.brueck.titel: This is the fastening the portraits are about.
journal.brueck.wa.label: Limited series
journal.brueck.wa.text: Japanese patterns in silver. Numbered. Never made again.
journal.cta.sub: You have read six verdicts. The seventh is yours.
journal.halim.cover: She does not take them off at all any more, right into the bath.
journal.halim.einordnung: She answers the question of what happens when you never take earrings off at all.
journal.halim.rolle: Singer-songwriter with a major label debut in 2007, and a surfer.
journal.halim.text: Small, plain shapes are what she likes best, and she still enjoys the sparkle of the cubic zirconia. Her styling point: when nothing goes to plan, fixing your hair, putting on lipstick and putting in earrings change the mood completely.
journal.hinweis.herkunft.text: The portraits appeared in the Japanese Baqless journal (text by Soichi Toyama, photography by Akane Watanabe). Summary and translation into English: Lorien Group. The only literal quotation is the highlighted line from Taeko Wako, everything else is summarised. Before we go live we obtain approval from the people portrayed for the English version and add the portrait photographs. Three further portraits are on file and are not yet translated.
journal.hinweis.schweiz.text: The stops above apply to Japan. We list them with their source and location, not as local references. As soon as there are locations and events in Switzerland, they will take their place here.
journal.igawa.cover: The same logic as her own brand: cover a weak point.
journal.igawa.einordnung: She judges the construction as the brand director of her own label, not only as someone who wears them.
journal.igawa.rolle: Brand director of the swimwear label Nala, founded in 2021. Found her factories through a search engine, without a single industry contact, and wrote to them cold.
journal.igawa.text: Everyday life often means breaking into a run without warning, and then a fastening is suddenly missing. Heavy, bulky earrings are out of the question. What convinces her is the same attitude she gives her own brand: being able to reach for them in the morning without hesitating, instead of weighing up the occasion.
journal.kobori.cover: In the tea room she wears no jewellery. That is exactly why this construction interests her.
journal.kobori.einordnung: She names the limit herself: in the tea room she wears nothing. That is what makes her verdict useful.
journal.kobori.rolle: Tea ceremony master of the Enshu school, second daughter of the 13th grand master. Before that, a lacrosse international at a world championship.
journal.kobori.text: While she prepares the tea she wears nothing at all, because a falling earring could damage the bowl. Otherwise she often only notices in the mirror that she has any on. For her, an earring that does not fall out is the first one she can even imagine in the tea room.
journal.kolophon.titel: So it is clear where this page comes from.
journal.kopf.lead: We were not looking for reviews. We were looking for people who have worn these earrings for years. What came out of it is better: six women who, independently of one another, tell the same story.
journal.kopf.titel: Six women who never take them off.
journal.nakajima.cover: She wore them through a 100‑mile race and forgot about them mid‑run.
journal.nakajima.einordnung: Her test is the hardest: 100 miles in one go, without reaching up to her ear once.
journal.nakajima.rolle: Ultramarathon runner from Tsukuba. 300 to 450 kilometres a month, four completed 100-mile races. She invented her own profession and gave it its name.
journal.nakajima.text: At the aid station she can lie down without a second thought. With ordinary studs she was forever checking whether both were still there. Her verdict on durability is a dry one: strikingly sturdy, and even the hoops do not bend out of shape.
journal.portraets.sub: Five portraits, five occupations, five dates. Under each one is why this person is in the selection.
journal.portraets.titel: Five more lives, the same fastening.
journal.sena.cover: Half a year around the world, with three T‑shirts in her bag.
journal.sena.einordnung: All her luggage fits in a rucksack. Whatever comes along has to earn its place.
journal.sena.rolle: Model and artist, diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at 18. A trip around the world while on insulin therapy, Kilimanjaro, two marathons.
journal.sena.text: On the trip she wore hoops the whole time, so naturally that she forgot she had them on. As a backpacker carrying medical supplies, there is barely room for clothes. That is exactly why it matters what make-up and jewellery can build up in your sense of self.
journal.stationen.billabong.text: Booth at the surf contest, 16 to 21 September, with over 25’000 visitors and over 200 surfers.
journal.stationen.hulle_fukuoka.text: The first shop-in-shop, around 150 items on site, with mirror displays for trying them on.
journal.stationen.hulle_hiroshima.text: Second shop-in-shop at the activewear retailer, opened on 24 July.
journal.stationen.intro: The brand does not put itself in display cases. It goes to beaches, to running events and into sports shops. All of the stops below took place in Japan.
journal.stationen.pilgrim.text: A series of initials, deliberately sold as single earrings only, so that two different letters can be combined.
journal.stationen.popup.text: Two weeks in womenswear retail, from 11 to 24 September.
journal.stationen.popup.titel: Pop-up at Spick and Span, Yurakucho
journal.stationen.tsujido.text: Second year on the beach. This is where the only unprompted customer comment in the whole set comes from: she was genuinely pleased that it did not fall out while surfing.
journal.wako.einordnung: Of the six, she is the only one who assesses jewellery for a living. She took Baqless into her own selection.
journal.wako.quelle: Source: Baqless Journal Japan, portrait from 9 July 2024
journal.wako.rolle: Sales professional and style consultant at Beams in Shonan. Opening team for five stores, then a buyer. A runner, and now a trail runner too.
journal.wako.text1: She is the only one of the six who assesses jewellery for a living, and she has taken Baqless into her own curation. They stay in round the clock, in the shower and asleep as well.
journal.wako.text2: Classic studs went missing on her, or caught on her scarf in winter. That is exactly why doing without a back convinced her. Between work and everyday life, the effort jewellery costs falls away completely, and as a fashion retailer she wants to look well turned out when she trains, too.
journal.wako.titel: The woman who judges jewellery for a living.
journal.wako.zitat: “365 days a year, indispensable in my life.”
journal.zahlen.fotos.label: Why there are no faces here
journal.zahlen.fotos.text: The portrait photographs are not yet approved. Rather than drop in someone else's pictures, we let the sentences stand: on every colour panel is the line that stayed with us from that person. The photographs follow as soon as we are allowed to show them.
journal.zahlen.jahre.label: years
journal.zahlen.jahre.text: The first portrait dates from 2022, the last from 2025. No two of them fall in the same month.
journal.zahlen.portraets.label: portraits
journal.zahlen.portraets.text: Six women in six different jobs who have worn these earrings for years. Each portrait recorded separately.
journal.zahlen.sterne.label: stars, points, grades
journal.zahlen.sterne.text: We do not scale anything up here. Instead, under every portrait you will find when it appeared and where it comes from.
journal.zahlen.zitat.label: literal quotation
journal.zahlen.zitat.text: Only the highlighted line from Taeko Wako is in her own words. Everything else is summarised and translated.

pdp.halb.hinweis: A single one for your second piercing, or to mix with another pair.
pdp.halb.wofuer: You take a single earring for a second piercing, to combine with another pair, or as a replacement when one has gone missing.
pdp.handhabung.schritt1: Push in. The post slides through the piercing like any ordinary stud.
pdp.handhabung.schritt2: A quarter turn on the earring.
pdp.handhabung.schritt3: Click. The T-bar locks in crossways. It stays until you release it yourself.
pdp.handhabung.schritt4: And out again. A second quarter turn puts the anchor lengthwise, then it slides through. You do that deliberately, it does not happen by accident.
pdp.handhabung.text: Closes with one hand. No mirror, no fumbling behind your ear.
pdp.mech.folge.text: You no longer have to take them out in the evening. No back that ends up in the basin. No hunting through the bedding. No second pair in your bag, just in case.
pdp.mech.folge.titel: And what does that mean day to day?
pdp.mech.hinweis: You set the grip yourself by shifting the turned part of the post.
pdp.mech.schritt1.text: The T-shaped post lies lengthways and slides through the piercing like any ordinary stud.
pdp.mech.schritt2.text: A small turn on the earring, with one hand, without a mirror.
pdp.mech.schritt3.text: The bar now sits crossways behind your earlobe. It cannot go back.
pdp.mech.titel: How it holds without a back
pdp.nachkauf.lead: So you know what happens before you order.

pdp.nachkauf.schritt4.text: Push in, turn, click. If something is not right, you have 30 days, and we refund to the same means of payment.

pdp.sorge.titel: What people ask before they buy
pdp.sorge.wasser.antwort: Stays in in the shower and in the sea. After the sea you rinse them briefly with fresh water, and that is all. We name the one exception ourselves: models with a real pearl come out first, and it says so below under care.
pdp.sorge.wasser.frage: Do I have to take them out to shower?
pdp.spec.stift_wert: Surgical stainless steel, the only part made of steel

pdp.zweck.amity-friendship: Made for two. Whether that is two people or two piercings in one ear is up to you.
pdp.zweck.amity-luna: A pearl for a whole day, not for two hours. For everyone who likes pearls and has no patience for a jewellery box.
pdp.zweck.amity-polaris: For the evening where one spark is enough. Small enough for the office, bright enough for the restaurant afterwards.
pdp.zweck.embrace-band: The shape of a hoop, without the fiddling when you close it. For everyone who likes hoops and never liked fastenings.
pdp.zweck.embrace-sage: The enamel is colourfast and water-resistant. So neon here is not one evening out, it is a whole week at a time.
pdp.zweck.embrace-zirkonia: For the occasion where photographs get taken. Sparkle at the front, and at the back a post standing crosswise.
pdp.zweck.honesty-dew: The small beginning. For a first Baqless pair, and for everyone who already wears a lot and is looking for one quiet point.
pdp.zweck.honesty-leaf: For the day with a full schedule: meeting, dinner, last train. You put them in once and leave them there.
pdp.zweck.honesty-minelta: For everyone who likes gold and still would rather not stand out. It works with a shirt at the office and with a towel by the lake.
pdp.zweck.honesty-slice: The pair for every day. You click them in first thing and notice at night that you never once thought about them.
pdp.zweck.standard: Earrings with Click-Lock: push in, quarter turn, click. You never need a back for them.
pdp.zweck.wa-hamon: For the day when a pattern says more than a stone. What you wear is a line, not a setting.
pdp.zweck.wa-kumo: A cloud instead of a wave, a cloud instead of an ink stroke. For the day when you do not want to explain anything.
pdp.zweck.wa-sumiiri: Sumiiri means the ink mark, the first stroke on empty paper. For the day you begin something.
plp.editorial.text: Every pair is set, polished and checked one by one.
plp.fix.a.text: Three moves, and you hear the last one. There is no back that can work loose and vanish in the bed.
plp.fix.b.text: The same metal sits under every finish. Only the post behind the ear is surgical stainless steel.
plp.fix.c.text: We name the one exception ourselves: take the freshwater pearl of Amity Luna out first.
plp.fix.c.titel: Stays in in the shower and in the sea
plp.gruppe.limitiert.text: Embrace Sage in neon pink, plus the three WA motifs from Japan: Sumiiri, Hamon and Kumo.
plp.gruppe.neu.text: From three collections at once: Honesty, Amity and Embrace. They sit at the front because they are new, not because they are about to go.
plp.gruppe.rest.text: Neither time-limited nor numbered. If you are trying Baqless for the first time, this is the place to start.
plp.kol.alle.material: Sterling silver 925, post in surgical stainless steel
plp.kol.alle.text: Honesty is the quiet start. Amity adds a stone and a pearl. Embrace gets seen. WA is the numbered edition from Japan. Tap a name above and this box tells you what that collection stands for and who it is for.
plp.kol.amity.material: Sterling silver 925, with 18 carat gold plating or rhodium-plated, some with cubic zirconia or a freshwater pearl
plp.kol.amity.text: Amity is the collection that sparkles. Polaris carries a cubic zirconia, in gold or in silver. Luna carries a freshwater pearl. Friendship is a duo: wear both, or pass one on. To be straight with you: the pearl is the one piece in the shop you take out before a shower. It does not like chemicals.
plp.kol.amity.titel: A stone, a pearl, a pair to share.
plp.kol.embrace.material: Sterling silver 925, with 18 carat gold plating or neon enamel, some with cubic zirconia
plp.kol.embrace.text: Embrace wraps around the earlobe instead of just passing through it. Band is a slim hoop in gold. Zirkonia sets stones on top. Sage comes in neon pink, as a limited run. It does not get more visible than this. The fastening behind them is the same as on everything else.
plp.kol.embrace.titel: For when it should be seen.
plp.kol.honesty.material: Sterling silver 925, with 18 carat gold plating, enamel or a black coating
plp.kol.honesty.text: Honesty is where it starts. Pared-back shapes, little surface, nothing that catches on a scarf. A leaf, a drop, a straight line. For everyone who clicks in once in the morning and never thinks about it again. Dew is the least expensive way in.
plp.kol.wa.text: WA is the series from Japan. Three motifs in rhodium-plated Sterling silver: Sumiiri, the ink mark, Hamon, the wave pattern on the blade of Japanese swords, and Kumo, the cloud. Every edition is numbered, and the Roman numeral in the name keeps the count. What runs out here does not come back in the same form.
plp.kollektion.hero.text: Every pair with Click-Lock. Sterling silver 925, water-resistant, built for every day. Find yours.
plp.kollektion.hero.text2: Four collections, one fastening. This page tells you what each one stands for, who it is for and what you actually decide here.
plp.meta.kollektion.beschreibung: All Baqless collections: Honesty, Amity, Embrace and the numbered WA series. Every pair with Click-Lock, Sterling silver 925, every model also as a single earring.
plp.neuheiten.hero.text: The newest pairs first, the limited WA series right behind them. All with Click-Lock, all for every day.
plp.neuheiten.hero.text2: The most recently added pairs first, the limited editions right behind them, then the permanent range. All with Click-Lock.
plp.neuheiten.legende.limitiert: A limited edition. Once it is gone, it is not issued again. The WA series is numbered on top of that.
plp.neuheiten.legende.neu: Most recently added to the range. These pairs belong to the permanent range, they are not time-limited.
plp.neuheiten.legende.titel: What the two labels on the images mean
plp.schluss.a.text: The fastening needs room for a quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it will not turn. That is the limit, and we would rather name it now than after you unwrap the box. If you are unsure, measure the thickness of your earlobe and ask us.
plp.schluss.a.titel: Will the fastening fit my ear?
plp.schluss.b.text: 30-day returns. Unworn, the original packaging is enough. We ship from Switzerland to CH, DE, AT, FR, IT and FL, and from Japan to the rest of the world. Free shipping from CHF 99.
plp.schluss.b.titel: And if it does not fit after all?
plp.schluss.c.text: Eight years for one click. The fastening is our own development and is protected by patent. Developed in Switzerland, handcrafted. How it came about is in the Story.
plp.schluss.titel: Three things we would rather say up front.
plp.schluss.weiter_kol: Every pair is in the catalogue, grouped by collection, with a text on each collection.
plp.schluss.weiter_neu: The pairs that arrived most recently have a page of their own.
plp.sort.label: Sort
plp.wahl.a.text: {n} of {alle} pairs already carry their measurements, in millimetres, against a scale on the product page. There the range runs from 3.40 by 3.40 millimetres to 15.36 millimetres long, plus a hoop measuring 12 by 13 millimetres across. The rest are still to come.
plp.wahl.b.text: Over the Sterling silver 925 sits 18 carat gold plating, rhodium plating, a black coating or enamel. That choice is about looks. Three pairs carry a cubic zirconia, one carries a freshwater pearl.
plp.wahl.c.text: Every model is also sold as a single earring. One earring costs around sixty per cent of the pair price, currently from {ab}. That way you can mix two models, or start with just one.
plp.wahl.c.titel: A pair or a single earring?
plp.wahl.lead: The fastening is the same on every pair. What differs is size, finish and how loudly a pair speaks. Three questions get you there.

start.clicklock.svg_label: Interactive animation of the Click-Lock fastening
start.clicklock.text: No back. No searching. No losing. The T‑bar slides through the ear, turns, clicks and settles crossways. Eight years of precision work, one movement.
start.film.text: Two loops, one fastening. Click a video to pause it. The Click‑Lock never pauses.
start.film.text2: One worn shot and two loops: one in motion, one right up close to the fastening. Click a video and it pauses.
start.fragen.drei_antwort: 30-day returns from receipt, unworn and in the original packaging. On production faults, one year from purchase: with proof of purchase we repair or replace, free of charge.
start.fragen.eins_antwort: Yes. The fastening only opens when you deliberately turn it back. Showering, sport, sleeping: it stays where it is. Do not simply take our word for it, try the demo and give it a tug.
start.fragen.text: Before the first pair, it is nearly always the same three doubts. Here is the answer to each, including where it speaks against us.
start.fragen.titel: Three questions we would rather answer beforehand.
start.fragen.zwei_antwort: Nearly always, but not always. Behind the earlobe, the anchor needs room for the quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it cannot rotate. We would rather say so before than after.
start.hero.siegel: ONE CLICK · NO GOING BACK · BAQLESS ·
start.hero.text: Push in, turn, click. Your earrings stay put: through your workout, in the shower, in the sea. No back to dig in or disappear. Developed in Switzerland, handcrafted.
start.hero.video_label: Baqless in motion: training in Baqless earrings
start.kollektionen.text: Four collections, each with its own character. The hold is always the same.
start.kollektionen.text2: Four collections, four signatures. Honesty is the clean line, Amity goes for stone and pearl, Embrace for colour and shape, WA for Japanese patterns in a numbered edition. How many pairs a world holds is written on its tile.
start.kollektionen.wa_hinweis: The fourth world is further down: WA, our limited series with Japanese patterns.
start.mechanik.fakt1_text: The jewellery is real silver, depending on the model rhodium-plated, plated with 18 carat gold or set with enamel. Only the post that goes through the piercing is surgical stainless steel. The full material list is on every product page.
start.mechanik.fakt2_text: Water-resistant, every day. You do not need to take them out for sport, and not for sleeping either. One exception, and we name it ourselves: models with a real pearl are better taken out for showering and swimming, and that is on their product page too.
start.mechanik.fakt2_titel: Stays in in the shower and in the sea
start.mechanik.fakt3_text: If the fastening sits too loosely or too tightly, you move the turned part of the post along a little. That works with one hand, without a mirror, without tools. A back cannot do that.
start.mechanik.nachher_bild: Drawing: post through the earlobe, behind it the T-anchor turning crosswise and locking
start.mechanik.nachher_text: At the end of the post sits a T-shaped anchor. Lengthwise it goes through the piercing like an ordinary stud. A quarter turn, and it lies crosswise behind it. No back. Nothing to lose.
start.mechanik.text: The difference sits behind the ear, where nobody photographs it. Two drawings show it: the stud you know, and ours.
start.mechanik.titel:
A stud earring has two parts.
We left one of them out.
start.mechanik.vorher_bild: Drawing: post through the earlobe, behind it a loose back falling away
start.mechanik.vorher_text: The back holds by clamping force alone. It comes off when you change clothes, it catches on your scarf, it drops down the plughole. And it is exactly the part people keep buying again.
start.nachkauf.drei_text: 30 days from receipt, unworn and in the original packaging. The procedure, the form and the address are under Shipping & returns. If it does not suit you, tell us briefly why. That helps us more than a silent return.
start.nachkauf.eins_text: Two steps, no account. Then three emails follow: the receipt, the acceptance after the stock check, and the dispatch notice with a tracking number. You pay with TWINT, card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

start.produkte.text2: Fifteen models, one fastening. Every one comes as a pair and as a single earring, for the second piercing or for mixing. The single price is on every card, so you can place the pair price.

start.stimmen.hinweis: These voices come from our Journal portraits.
start.stimmen.text: From everyday life, not from a studio.
start.stimmen.text2: Three portraits from the Japanese Baqless site, translated for this page. The source sits under every voice, and only what is marked as a quotation is quoted word for word. You will find no stars and no average scores: invented reviews do not go on our site.
start.story.text1: An idea from jewellery design, built with the precision of a Swiss watchmaker: an earring that holds without a back.
start.story.text2: Developed in Switzerland, handcrafted. Fewer parts, more freedom.
start.vorteile.silber_text: Real silver jewellery. Only the post at the back is surgical stainless steel.
start.vorteile.wasserfest_text: Shower, sport, sea. You never have to take them out.
start.wa.text: Traditional Japanese patterns, made for the WA‑series. Each edition is numbered. None will be made again.
story.atelier.bild_alt: The workshop: workbenches at the window, everything made by hand
story.atelier.bildunterschrift: The workshop: small benches, big windows, no assembly lines.
story.cta.text: The fastening is the same on every pair. The rest is taste.
story.dich.grenze.text: The anchor needs room behind the earlobe for the quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it cannot swing crosswise. We say so before you buy, not after.
story.dich.lead: A company story only gets interesting when it ends at your ear. So here it is, line by line.
story.dich.risiko.text: Then you send them back. 30 days from delivery, unworn and in the original packaging.
story.dich.risiko.titel: And if it still does not fit.
story.dich.stimmen.text: We went looking for people who have worn these earrings for years. Six of them describe in the Journal what that looks like day to day.
story.dich.stimmen.titel: We did not go looking for stars.
story.dich.z1.nachher: Nothing digs in at the back. You take them out when you want to.
story.dich.z1.vorher: Out in the evening so nothing digs in.
story.dich.z2.vorher: The back stays behind in a jumper, a drain, the sand.
story.dich.z3.vorher: Two hands, a mirror, three attempts.
story.dich.z4.nachher: Stays in in the shower and in the sea.
story.dich.z4.vorher: Out for the shower, out for the swim.
story.dich.z5.vorher: Too loose or too tight, and there is nothing you can do.
story.durst.a1.text: The fastening holds on its own. No counterpart, no clip, no hook.
story.durst.a2.text: And it opens again with one hand. No mirror, no tools, in the dark if need be.
story.durst.a3.text: Earlobes vary in thickness. One fixed setting sits well on one person and presses on the next.
story.durst.a4.text: Water-resistant also means never spared. A fastening you do not take out goes through everything, every day.
story.durst.text1: In a row of figures that looks good. In the workshop it looks different. In all that time there was no shop, no customers and nothing to show. There were four requirements, and each one got in the way of the others.
story.durst.text2: Each one on its own is simple. Together they are the problem.
story.durst.warum.text: A decorative part has to look right. A fastening has to hold, every day, without you thinking about it. That cannot be drawn. It gets built, worn, thrown out and built again. That is what took eight years.
story.durst.warum.titel: A fastening is not a decorative part.
story.entwicklung.bild_alt: Final polishing of a Baqless earring by hand
story.entwicklung.text1: Eight years of sketching, building and scrapping it again. Prototype after prototype, until the fastening was finally right: a T‑bar that swings crossways with a quarter turn and holds.
story.entwicklung.text2: Push in, turn, click. At the gym, in the shower, in the sea. Without ever thinking about a back again.
story.hero.text: The story of an earring that holds without a back.
story.idee.bild_alt: Design sketches of the Click-Lock fastening on paper
story.idee.text1: It began with an annoyance you know well: the back presses into your ear on the phone, pinches at night and one day it is simply gone. Usually on the very day you most want to wear the earring.
story.idee.text2: The question behind it was simple. Why does an earring need a counterpart that only gets in the way? The answer took rather longer.
story.kap1.text1: You know the moment. The back digs in when you are on the phone. At night it pinches, so you take the earrings out. In the morning one of the two backs is somewhere else entirely, and you wear something different.
story.kap1.text2: It is no disaster. It is a small annoyance every day, and at some point you stop noticing it.
story.kap1.text3: In 2010 someone did notice, and asked the question nobody asks: why does an earring need a counterpart that only gets in the way? The question is quick to ask. The answer took eight years.
story.kap2.text1: An earring without a back has to do two things at once that contradict each other: hold on its own, and open again with one hand. That is exactly where it got stuck for eight years.
story.kap2.text2: In the end it was a T. A flat anchor at the end of the post. You push it in like an ordinary stud, turn it a quarter turn, and the anchor sits crosswise behind the earlobe. Click. It opens by turning back, not by pulling.
story.kap2.text3: How firmly it grips is up to you. You shift the turned part of the post a little, with one hand, without a mirror.
story.kap3.text3: Fewer parts also means less that can go missing. No spare part to reorder. No little bag of backs in a drawer.
story.manufaktur.bild_alt: A Baqless earring being made by hand in the workshop
story.manufaktur.text1: Every pair is set, polished and checked one by one before it travels to you.
story.manufaktur.text2: Sterling silver 925, water-resistant and made for every day. Only the post behind the ear is surgical stainless steel, right where the mechanics matter. Fewer parts, more freedom.
story.moment.text1: No diagram, no presentation, no brochure. Push in, turn, click. Anyone can claim that something holds. The click you can hear.
story.moment.text2: From that click on it was no longer about mechanics. It was about jewellery.

story.vorspann.lead: The back is the smallest part of an earring. And the only one that decides whether you wear it today or go looking for it.
story.vorspann.text1: In 2010 someone stopped putting up with it. What came of that took eight years. Not eight years of marketing. Eight years of mechanics.
story.vorspann.text2: In 2018 the fastening was finished. It is called Click-Lock. This is the story of what happened in between.
story.zahlen.unterzeile: All that reaches you of it is the click.
